title: Carbon Cycle Monitoring
definition: Carbon cycle monitoring tracks carbon stored in reservoirs and exchanged among the land, ocean, inland water and atmosphere. It combines several kinds of quantity: atmospheric concentration, biomass or other carbon stocks, and fluxes between reservoirs. These are connected but not interchangeable. A satellite measurement of reflected or emitted radiation must be retrieved into a geophysical variable, while a surface flux often requires atmospheric transport or ecosystem modelling.
